entries.question: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:509-520 proves aliceId is {utaId}|{nativeKey}, not AccountId|SubAccountId; :784-791 only stamps sub-account IDs in commit messages and leaves Operation/GitCommit untouched. Historical events therefore lack a reversible subAccountId mapping; migration must require an explicit manifest or linked observation and otherwise remain Unavailable, never derive subAccountId from nativeKey.
entries.evidence: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:509-520 and :784-791; MAP-CA5605FEB6; K01/K02/K03; C01 in integration-decisions.md.
entries.resolution: Historical aliceId contains utaId|nativeKey and commit-message sub tags do not bind each Operation/GitCommit. Import accepts only an explicit manifest or linked observation; without it the historical scope is Unavailable and nativeKey is never converted to SubAccountId.

entries.question: The product policy for FIFO/lot tracking, short exposure, splits and token migrations remains an evidence decision; no unsupported policy should be represented as WAC reset.
entries.evidence: Accounting source only demonstrates spot WAC behavior; MAP-977FF0C895; K03/K04/K08; C13 in integration-decisions.md.
entries.resolution: For the source-backed declared spot capability, a versioned policy may select SpotWac for confirmed spot fills. FIFO/lot, short exposure, splits, and token migrations require their own explicit policy and evidence; otherwise they produce UnsupportedAccountingPolicy/Unavailable and never reset WAC.

entries.question: Whether a venue reports cumulative fills or per-execution fills must be verified per adapter; the decoder must not infer one from the legacy sync shape.
entries.evidence: cost-basis.spec.ts:266-301 only supplies one syncOrders operation/result shape; adapter designs and C10 require native observation evidence.
entries.resolution: The decoder carries a FillMeasure variant for cumulative cursor versus per-execution identity. Until the adapter declares which measure is evidenced, the observation is Unknown/CapabilityUnavailable and cannot create a FillEvent or infer semantics from positional sync results.

entries.question: Venue-specific correction semantics and execution identifiers need adapter evidence; until supplied, correction remains UnsupportedCorrection and recovery-required.
entries.evidence: cost-basis.spec.ts:302-374 proves only legacy origin/sync pairing; C10 and broker adapter designs explicitly do not prove native correction identity.
entries.resolution: FillCorrection is enabled only with venue-provided correction identity/link evidence. Missing or conflicting identity remains UnsupportedCorrection and RecoveryRequired; no second fill is emitted.

entries.question: Which legacy Git records can be imported as confirmed fills versus requiring reconciliation requires migration evidence and must be recorded as an import policy.
entries.evidence: cost-basis.ts:1-24; MAP-D807137749; K05/K08/K11; legacy Git records contain no migration manifest in this source.
entries.resolution: Migration requires a per-record import manifest. Only records whose scope, instrument, execution identity, side, quantity, price, and order are evidenced become FillEvent; mark bootstrap or incomplete records become authorized reconciliation candidates or Unavailable, never confirmed fills.

entries.question: Whether policyVersion is global or instrument-specific must align with the accounting-policy registry and migration table.
entries.evidence: CostBasisProjection is keyed by AccountScope+InstrumentId in analyses target and by the shared C01/C08 policy bindings.
entries.resolution: policyVersion is instrument-specific: it binds the AccountingPolicy registry revision, AccountScope, InstrumentId/instrument class, and migration version. A global version cannot authorize a differently scoped policy; mismatch returns ProjectionVersionConflict.

entries.question: The legacy Git migration ordering and missing timestamps require an import manifest; do not infer durable sequence from filesystem order.
entries.evidence: cost-basis.ts:38-134 uses array order/current timestamps; TradingGit import behavior is not a durable sequence source.
entries.resolution: Legacy import requires a manifest with explicit sequence/observedAt or linked evidence. Filesystem order and generated current time are rejected; absent ordering/timestamp evidence yields Unavailable/ReplayViolation while sibling records remain attributable.

entries.question: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:509-520 defines aliceId as {utaId}|{nativeKey}; only :784-791 records sub-account tags in commit messages, and Operation/GitCommit do not carry a subAccountId field. Historical composite-id to subAccountId mapping remains unavailable without linked evidence.
entries.evidence: cost-basis.ts:136-148 plus UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:509-520,:784-791 and C01.
entries.resolution: Historical composite IDs are not reversible scope keys. Decode only separately evidenced AccountId/SubAccountId; otherwise retain the row as Unavailable and do not derive SubAccountId from nativeKey.

entries.question: Short accounting and close semantics require product policy; until selected, return UnsupportedCloseDirection rather than assume long spot.
entries.evidence: cost-basis.ts:150-167 demonstrates the unsafe non-SELL/close defaults; C02 and the Accounting target already define typed close direction.
entries.resolution: Only an explicitly selected source-backed long-spot policy with scoped exposure evidence may map close to sell. Short close requires a selected ShortExposure policy and exposure evidence; absent policy or evidence returns UnsupportedCloseDirection without mutating basis, and no action default is allowed.

entries.question: Whether an observation without execution price can later be completed by the same identity depends on venue callback semantics; model it as a stateful observation update, not a new fill.
entries.evidence: cost-basis.ts:169-173 omits observeExternalOrder and gives no venue callback identity contract.
entries.resolution: An identity-preserving callback may update an existing Pending observation to Confirmed and then emit one FillEvent; a new identity is not a completion. Until venue identity/update semantics are evidenced, retain Pending/Unknown and do not invent execution price or fill.

entries.question: The vendor snapshot schema and timestamp field must be verified per provider adapter before accepting it as Confirmed.
entries.evidence: fx-service.spec.ts:1-11 supplies unchecked base/counter/last_rate records and empty client methods; C10 forbids treating this fixture as provider schema evidence.
entries.resolution: Each provider adapter must runtime-decode its snapshot schema and observation timestamp. Unknown/malformed schema or missing provider time returns Malformed/Unavailable; it cannot become Confirmed through the fixture shape.

entries.question: None; identity semantics are fixed by currency units.
entries.evidence: fx-service.spec.ts:13-28 returns rate one without provider access; MAP-592DD5394C; K03/K05/K11 defines identity conversion by equal CurrencyCode.
entries.resolution: Same-currency conversion is IdentityConversion with no provider observation or fabricated timestamp; amount and currency units are preserved, including zero.

entries.question: The exact yfinance payload schema and provider timestamp semantics require adapter evidence; the domain must reject unknown shapes until mapped.
entries.evidence: fx-service.spec.ts:30-43 checks only a positive yfinance number; MAP-612CCE1A5D; K03/K05/K07 and C10 require provider schema/time evidence.
entries.resolution: The yfinance adapter must map an exact payload/pair and provider observation time before Confirmed. Unknown payload, pair, non-finite/non-positive rate, or missing provider time returns Malformed/Unavailable and cannot enter valuation.

entries.question: TTL and stale-admission durations are policy/configuration evidence and must be recorded with valuation results.
entries.evidence: Accounting analyses target already separates injected Clock/cache from valuation authority; C10 distinguishes policy configuration from source evidence.
entries.resolution: TTL and stale admission are required injected FreshnessPolicy values, never hidden defaults. Missing/invalid policy yields CapabilityUnavailable or StaleNotAdmissible; any accepted classification persists the policy/version with valuation evidence.

entries.question: Maximum stale age and which consumers may accept estimates require product/risk policy evidence.
entries.evidence: MAP-F57EB058EB; K03/K05/K08; C13 separates display uncertainty from authoritative account/risk decisions.
entries.resolution: Confirmed/Identity is the default for authoritative equity, risk, and reservations; Estimated/Stale may be displayed only with explicit status and evidence. No consumer silently accepts stale data, and absent policy rejects it.

entries.question: Who may approve default FX for risk/reservation decisions remains a product-policy decision; conservative default is reject for authoritative equity.
entries.evidence: MAP-1B24CAB86B; K03/K05/K08; dated defaults are not broker facts and data lookup has no order-approval semantics.
entries.resolution: Default FX remains an Estimated(DefaultFxObservation), never a broker fact. A persisted non-trading EstimateAdmissionPolicy may admit it for an explicitly estimate-enabled display/query consumer; no actor or order-approval path is implied, while authoritative equity/risk/reservation rejects it and records EstimateNotAdmissible.

entries.question: Supported currency registry and behavior for delisted/temporary codes must be supplied by market-data configuration.
entries.evidence: fx-service.spec.ts:104-120 demonstrates the unsafe unknown-code 1:1/epoch path; the supported currency registry is external market-data configuration.
entries.resolution: The registry adapter must supply canonical supported, temporary, and delisted-code status. Until mapped, unknown/delisted codes return UnknownCurrency/ValuationUnavailable (including zero amounts); no 1:1 or epoch timestamp is created.

entries.question: Notification retention and dedupe window are observability policy decisions, not accounting semantics.
entries.evidence: fx-service.spec.ts:122-133 only tests a process-local warning Set; MAP-1CA6BEB099; K05/K08/K11 places notification effects outside valuation.
entries.resolution: Notification retention/dedupe cannot affect accounting. Persist valuation uncertainty first; an absent observability policy suppresses or expires notifications only, while structured valuation evidence remains durable and queryable.

entries.question: Whether UI may display a numeric estimated total while risk rejects it must be explicit per consumer policy.
entries.evidence: MAP-1955CFFDB9; K03/K05/K11/K12 defines explicit ValuationResult and consumer separation.
entries.resolution: UI/query consumers may render a numeric Estimated/Stale total only with its uncertainty and policy status; risk, reservation, and authoritative equity require Confirmed/Identity and otherwise return Partial/Rejected. Zero does not bypass currency validation.

entries.question: Registry contents and alias policy must be sourced from the supported market-data configuration.
entries.evidence: fx-service.spec.ts:168-175 proves only uppercase normalization; registry contents and aliases are not in this source.
entries.resolution: The market-data registry must define supported codes and aliases. Until an alias is explicitly mapped, malformed/unregistered/delisted code input returns InvalidCurrencyCode/UnsupportedCurrency; uppercase alone never authorizes a pair.

entries.question: Hub API table schema, timestamp semantics and freshness SLA require live contract evidence; until verified, adapter capability remains explicitly unverified.
entries.evidence: fx-service.spec.ts:177-228 stubs global fetch and ad-hoc table values; C10 requires live hub contract evidence.
entries.resolution: Hub use remains explicitly unverified until response schema, provider observation timestamp, table identity, and freshness SLA are evidenced. Decoder returns HubMalformed/HubUnavailable/StaleTable and never marks a missing timestamp as current.

entries.question: SLA and policy thresholds for stale/default acceptance remain a product/risk decision.
entries.evidence: MAP-C3F063DA6A; K03/K05/K08 defines safe valuation variants; no hardcoded SLA is needed for correctness.
entries.resolution: The default valuation admission is Confirmed/Identity only. Stale/default thresholds are required configuration; without them stale/default values remain Estimated or Unavailable and cannot authorize equity, risk, or reservations.

entries.question: Protocol field naming/version and decimal wire encoding must match shared protocol model decisions.
entries.evidence: MAP-3FBA652916; K02/K03/K05/K07; shared protocol decisions define serializable DecimalString/CurrencyCode/Instant and valuation variants.
entries.resolution: Use the shared protocol field names, schema version, canonical decimal strings, and explicit ValuationResult evidence; the mapper rejects out-of-contract values and never silently quantizes or drops provenance.

entries.question: Default-data refresh cadence and approval owner need explicit operational evidence.
entries.evidence: fx-service.ts:42-71 contains a mutable dated table; MAP-A46E156A09; K03/K05/K11 requires immutable versioned defaults plus explicit non-trading admission policy.
entries.resolution: The accounting kernel defines no refresh cadence or operational approval authority. A released immutable dataset must carry version/releasedAt, and any consumer admission uses a separate non-trading EstimateAdmissionPolicy; absent release or policy metadata leaves the estimate unavailable rather than silently refreshing or treating it as live.

entries.question: Cache TTL and stale window require agreed market-data policy.
entries.evidence: fx-service.ts:73-79 exposes Date.now TTL cache; Accounting analyses target uses injected Clock and non-authoritative cache.
entries.resolution: Cache TTL/stale windows are required FreshnessPolicy inputs and are recorded with accepted valuations. Missing policy returns explicit unavailable/stale-not-admissible; cache eviction never changes journaled valuation.

entries.question: Which provider is mandatory for each broker/account requires capability registry evidence.
entries.evidence: fx-service.ts:81-103 makes the client optional and has no broker/account capability registry; C09/C10 require scoped capability evidence.
entries.resolution: A scoped capability registry may record required provider coverage for a particular broker/account when product policy designates it. Until a provider is evidenced for that scope, cross-currency lookup returns CapabilityUnavailable/UnknownFx and does not use an optional client as confirmation.

entries.question: Hub endpoint response schema and freshness SLA require external contract evidence before enabling as confirmed source.
entries.evidence: fx-service.ts:105-138 casts hub JSON, substitutes Date.now for missing updatedAt, and serves old tables during backoff; live hub schema/SLA is absent.
entries.resolution: Hub adapter remains Unavailable/Malformed/Stale until schema, timestamp, and freshness evidence is supplied. It preserves the original provider timestamp and outage context; backoff never relabels old data as live.

entries.question: Provider precedence, stale windows and estimate acceptance remain policy/configuration evidence per consumer.
entries.evidence: fx-service.ts:140-205 has an implicit fallback ladder; MAP-B7DBA0C5CB; K03/K05/K07 defines explicit lookup/admission variants.
entries.resolution: Provider precedence is an explicit scoped policy (the current source ordering may be retained as a configured baseline), not a hidden fallback. Without policy/capability, return Unavailable; stale/default results retain evidence and cannot become Confirmed.

entries.question: Public protocol shape and precision/rounding rules must align with shared protocol-model decisions.
entries.evidence: MAP-2683B949E2; K02/K03/K05/K11; shared protocol decisions define the public valuation/result boundary and canonical decimal representation.
entries.resolution: The protocol mapper uses the shared ValuationResult/DecimalString/CurrencyCode contract, preserves scale and evidence, and rejects out-of-contract precision rather than silently quantizing; same-currency Identity is explicit.

entries.question: Legacy GitState import field mapping needs migration evidence; do not infer sequence from snapshot timestamps.
entries.evidence: order-history.spec.ts:8-41 contains zeroed GitState fixtures; MAP-7DA6DF620B; K03/K07/K11 makes GitState read-only and legacy identity incomplete.
entries.resolution: Legacy GitState import requires field-by-field migration evidence for scope, instrument, lifecycle, identities, sequence, and timestamps. Missing evidence produces LegacyEvidence/read-only or Unavailable; snapshot timestamp is never inferred as event sequence.

entries.question: Exact history status vocabulary and ordering tie-breaker must align with public protocol schema.
entries.evidence: MAP-51B32EF77E; K02/K03/K07/K11/K12 defines shared history lifecycle/provenance vocabulary and listing completeness.
entries.resolution: Accounting uses Working, PartiallyFilled, Filled, Cancelled, Expired, Rejected, UserRejected, Unknown, and Reconciling as public projection vocabulary; a provider emits only states its declared observation leaf can evidence. Local Prepared/PendingSubmit is non-remote pre-dispatch state, final history ordering is newest-first by descending journal sequence with deterministic event-identity tie-breaker after full reduction, and no missing status becomes terminal.

entries.question: Venue execution identity/correction semantics remain adapter evidence; unsupported identity stays explicit unavailable.
entries.evidence: order-history.spec.ts:122-168 only proves legacy origin/sync joining; adapter-specific execution/correction identity remains unproven under C10.
entries.resolution: Fill identity is accepted only from a declared source-specific identity: a controlled fill carries DispatchId plus the provider-declared broker/execution identity, while a proven external observation carries its provider-declared native/event identity. Until adapter evidence exists, preserve the observation as Unavailable/Unknown and do not deduplicate by array position or fabricate correction.

entries.question: Public HistoryContract optional field semantics and derivative canonicalization require protocol evidence.
entries.evidence: MAP-2A6F3FE722; K02/K03/K04/K07 defines HistoryInstrument/InstrumentDescriptor, required derivative fields, and optional projection terms.
entries.resolution: HistoryContract is a protocol projection of validated InstrumentDescriptor: required identity/currency and derivative canonical fields are enforced, optional absent terms remain Absent/Unavailable, and display/native symbols are never keys.

entries.question: Wire rounding/scale limits must match protocol schema; do not silently quantize in the mapper.
entries.evidence: MAP-66445C2610; K03/K07/K11 requires canonical encoding and boundary decoding; runtime validation remains a boundary obligation.
entries.resolution: Wire DecimalString scale/rounding is enforced by the shared schema/codec at the boundary. Accounting does not quantize in the mapper; over-scale, non-finite, or malformed values return ProtocolViolation/InvalidDecimal.

entries.question: Which native order fields are observable on each broker requires adapter capability evidence; unobservable fields must be explicit unavailable.
entries.evidence: order-history.ts:53-68 proves only legacy SDK field handling; ProtocolModels/adapter designs require per-broker capability evidence for native observability.
entries.resolution: Native field availability is represented as Present or Unavailable per adapter/schema. An unobservable optional field remains explicit Unavailable; missing required action/identity is Invalid/Unknown and never inferred from a legacy default.

entries.question: History ordering tie-breakers and status mapping must align with protocol model; no default terminal state.
entries.evidence: MAP-B34D1F5166; K02/K03/K07/K11/K12 supplies history lifecycle/provenance and complete/partial listing semantics.
entries.resolution: Use the shared lifecycle vocabulary and sort final rows newest-first by descending journal sequence with a deterministic event-identity tie-breaker after full reduction. Partial/Unavailable listing cannot imply cancel or a terminal state.

entries.question: Exact tax/reporting treatment for corrections and realized PnL is outside this legacy fold and needs accounting-policy evidence.
entries.evidence: MAP-0C54B9142F; K03/K05/K08/K11 separates correction facts, realized/unrealized PnL, and broker-reported facts.
entries.resolution: Correction/tax reporting is not synthesized by this legacy fold. Confirmed realized PnL requires an explicit closing-fill/basis policy; otherwise correction and realized reporting remain Unavailable/Unattributed while raw facts and broker AccountFacts are preserved.

entries.question: Venue rules for determining externally owned versus UTA-dispatched orders require per-adapter evidence and Complete listing scope.
entries.evidence: order-history.ts:254-263 infers external provenance from Git; C07 and adapter designs require complete per-namespace/listing evidence.
entries.resolution: External versus UTA-dispatched provenance must come from durable dispatch/native identity or an adapter observation. If namespace coverage is incomplete or identity is absent, retain Externality Unknown/Unavailable and never infer absence or ownership from a Git scan.

entries.question: Target module export names and protocol mapper placement must align with the shared source layout.
entries.evidence: MAP-B9E75F067C; K01/K02/K03/K07 defines typed domain exports and protocol projection ownership.
entries.resolution: The accounting package exports typed reducers/ports (`valuePosition`, `aggregateAccount`, `evolveCostBasis`) through the market-and-accounting boundary; ProtocolModels owns wire mappers/views, and legacy raw helper exports are removed after callers migrate.

entries.question: Derivative multiplier authority and supported fallback per venue must come from capability evidence; no blanket one default.
entries.evidence: position-math.spec.ts:5-60 proves arithmetic only; Identity and broker designs require per-instrument/venue multiplier capability evidence.
entries.resolution: Derivative multiplier authority is a capability observation, not a formula default. Until the venue/instrument registry supplies positive evidence, valuation is CapabilityUnavailable/Incomplete; explicit unit multiplier one is accepted only where metadata proves it.

entries.question: Whether broker-reported unrealized PnL should take precedence over derived PnL is broker/account policy; preserve both until decided.
entries.evidence: MAP-45921BE3BA; K03/K04/K08 requires preserving BrokerReported and Derived evidence separately.
entries.resolution: Broker-reported and derived PnL are both retained; neither silently supersedes the other in Accounting. Consumer policy may choose an authority for a specific decision, while mismatch remains a durable evidence/reconciliation result.

entries.question: Instrument classes for which multiplier one is intrinsic must be enumerated in the capability registry.
entries.evidence: position-math.spec.ts:77-89 only demonstrates the unsafe fallback; MAP-1DD062830E; K02/K03/K04 requires explicit instrument metadata.
entries.resolution: The capability registry must enumerate intrinsic unit-multiplier classes per venue. Until enumerated, missing/zero/invalid multiplier remains unavailable and does not become one.

entries.question: Per-broker treatment of short-sale proceeds, margin and collateral requires broker facts; default to explicit policy refusal when absent.
entries.evidence: position-math.spec.ts:91-138 proves one raw aggregation convention only; broker designs and C13 require per-account cash/margin/collateral evidence.
entries.resolution: Short proceeds, margin, collateral and fee treatment remain scoped AccountFacts/ExposureAccountingPolicy evidence. Missing broker semantics yields Partial/Rejected or explicit policy refusal; it never applies a global convention.

entries.question: Exact ownership split with Identity group PositionObservation schema must remain synchronized.
entries.evidence: MAP-D53569BA15; K02/K03/K04/K07 assigns canonical PositionObservation decoding to Identity and pure valuation/aggregation to Accounting.
entries.resolution: Identity owns the canonical PositionObservation schema and native decoding; Accounting owns valuePosition/cost basis/account aggregation. Changes cross the shared contract and cannot reintroduce IBroker.Position as authority.

entries.question: Decimal scale/rounding and wire encoding must follow shared protocol contract.
entries.evidence: MAP-A901893CDA; K03/K07/K11 defines canonical decimal strings and runtime boundary refinement.
entries.resolution: Decimal scale, rounding, sign, units, and wire encoding are enforced by the shared protocol/domain codec; Accounting calculations retain exact Decimal values and return InvalidDecimal/ProtocolViolation rather than silently coercing.

entries.question: Which optional broker fields can be absent versus required is adapter-specific evidence and must be encoded in capability/schema.
entries.evidence: position-math.ts:35-39 shows a generic fallback; Identity/broker designs state optional-versus-required fields vary by native adapter schema.
entries.resolution: Each adapter declares field availability/requiredness in its capability/schema. Missing optional fields become explicit Unavailable; missing required fields fail decoding or valuation, and present zero remains distinct from missing.

entries.question: Intrinsic multiplier rules for each secType/venue need capability evidence before accepting one.
entries.evidence: position-math.ts:41-46 proves only the unsafe one fallback; per-secType/venue multiplier capability is not in Accounting source.
entries.resolution: Intrinsic multiplier acceptance remains capability evidence. Until a secType/venue rule is observed, only explicit positive metadata is accepted; absent/zero/invalid values yield CapabilityUnavailable.

entries.question: Whether broker-reported marketValue/PnL supersedes derived output is policy; expose both evidence variants.
entries.evidence: MAP-6033F222D1; K03/K04/K08 requires BrokerReported and Derived valuation variants to coexist.
entries.resolution: Broker-reported marketValue/PnL is preserved as BrokerReported and derived output as Derived; Accounting never silently supersedes one. A consumer requiring one authority must state policy and receives mismatch/Partial when the pair disagrees.

entries.question: Migration must inventory all PnL callers, including hidden protocol/UI paths, before deleting the export.
entries.evidence: Repository callers are enumerated by source search: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:19,1097; brokers/contract-builder.ts:23,136; brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts:44,734; brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts:36,396; position-math.spec.ts:3; packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts:130.
entries.resolution: The migration inventory is complete for current source callers; all must move to the single typed ValuationResult field projection before removing the raw export. Hidden/UI/protocol use is covered by the protocol mapping boundary, and no caller may recompute raw PnL.

entries.question: Net liquidation formula and treatment of broker-reported totals versus reconstructed totals must be decided per broker capability.
entries.evidence: position-math.ts:81-118 lacks broker-specific NetLiquidation/margin semantics; IBKR/Longbridge/CCXT designs preserve native account facts but do not prove one universal formula.
entries.resolution: Account aggregation retains broker-reported totals and reconstructed Complete/Partial/Rejected variants. Per-broker net-liquidation composition, margin, collateral, and FX authority remain capability/account evidence; a complete derived total is authoritative only when the declared policy and all required scoped/unit/FX evidence are present, otherwise the result is Partial/Rejected.

entries.question: Per-broker short/margin semantics require live adapter/account evidence; no global convention beyond documented policy.
entries.evidence: position-math.ts:95-106 documents one proceeds assumption; broker adapter/account observations are required for short/margin semantics.
entries.resolution: Short/margin semantics remain per-broker AccountFacts and ExposureAccountingPolicy. Until cash-proceeds/margin treatment is evidenced, preserve signed facts and return policy refusal/Partial rather than apply a global subtraction.

entries.question: Exact account equity policy, broker native totals and margin semantics must be reconciled with each broker adapter before replacing current aggregation.
entries.evidence: position-math.ts:107-118 is an in-memory convention; C13 and broker designs require native equity/margin/FX evidence before replacement.
entries.resolution: Replacing aggregation requires per-broker equity policy, native total precedence, and margin semantics evidence. Where declared policy and complete scoped/unit/FX facts support derivation, expose the derived result alongside each signed native/broker fact; otherwise preserve those facts and expose Partial/Rejected, never substitute zero, one, or a universal reconstructed total.
